note: No cross-validation, no resampling -- train and test are two fully independent real-world datasets, so there is no leakage risk at all. permutation_p_value shuffles only the TRAINING labels and refits, never touching the held-out test set, so it's a clean significance check on a genuinely held-out generalization test. Task-matched: both sides use the continuous-passage task (MDVR-KCL ReadText, ItalianPVS B1), so this isolates language as the variable, unlike the earlier PR1-based run which conflated language and task type.
